    "Cost-effective solution for mid-sized IT departments"

  "cons": [
    "Lacks advanced security incident response features",
    "Reporting for SOC metrics could be more robust",
    "Integrations with specialized security tools are limited"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The security analyst found Zoho Desk to be a capable tool for managing general IT tickets and basic security incidents, appreciating its ability to centralize these operations. While it offered good value and customization for standard ITSM, they noted that its capabilities for advanced SOC functions and detailed security reporting were somewhat lacking. Despite these limitations, it served as a practical, cost-effective solution for their mid-sized IT and security operations."

json.overall_experience: The security analyst found Zoho Desk to be a capable tool for managing general IT tickets and basic security incidents, appreciating its ability to centralize these operations. While it offered good value and customization for standard ITSM, they noted that its capabilities for advanced SOC functions and detailed security reporting were somewhat lacking. Despite these limitations, it served as a practical, cost-effective solution for their mid-sized IT and security operations.
